This blog acts as a Joycean stream-of-consciousness record of the random tech-y things I'm experimenting with and learning. It started because I bought this domain name on a whim and thought it was too cool to not do something with. The purpose is to prevent things falling out of my goldfish brain. If you're reading this, I hope it benefits you too, though there's certainly no guarantee.

Please visit my website or LinkedIn for a slightly more professional persona.

### My AI policy for this blog

I write my own posts. As stated above, the main point of this blog is to keep things in my goldfish brain, and the only way to do that is by writing things myself.

I do use AI to help me code and to write up some boilerplate text like code chunks, code comments, and instructions. I always validate everything that AI helps me with, and will never mindlessly straight copy-paste output into a post.
